entry.summary:
If you prefer your superheroes off the books, you’ve likely been keeping your eyes on the My Hero Academia: Vigilantes anime. The anime adaptation of the spinoff was previously lined up for an April 7 premiere, and now Crunchyroll has confirmed plans for a simulcast.
There’s no exact time as of this writing, but Crunchyroll lists the following territories for streaming: North America, Central America, South America, Europe, Africa, Oceania, the Middle East, and CIS. Kenichi Suzuki (chief director of JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure) directs, with Yosuke Kuroda of My Hero Academia writing series composition and Takahiko Yoshida (Cells at Work) on character designs for the Bones production.
The story follows down-and-out college student Koichi Haimawairi, who has all but given up on his dream of being a superhero. Despite the fact that 80 percent of the population has powers known as Quirks, few are actually chosen to go down the path of the pro hero. Things change when Koichi and a young hero named Pop☆Step run into the vigilante Knuckleduster, who soon puts them both to work.
Shuichiro Umeda leads the voice cast as Koichi Haimawairi/The Crawler alongside Ikumi Hasegawa as Kazuho Haneyama/Pop☆Step and Yasuhiro Mamiya as Oguro Iwao/Knuckleduster.
Writer Hideyuki Furuhashi and illustrator Betten Court launched the manga as a spinoff of Kohei Horikoshi’s My Hero Academia back in August 2016. The anime adaptation comes just ahead of the eighth and final season of MHA proper, which drops this fall.

entry.title: How to get the Armorcharm and Powercharm in Monster Hunter Wilds
entry.summary:
Armorcharm and Powercharm are among two of the most valuable items you can use in Monster Hunter Wilds, and the two of them can significantly boost your base attack and defense.
There are different ways to boost your stats inside the game. One helpful way is to use different consumables, which temporarily boost your stats. Armorcharm and Powercharm's boosts work differently, and their locations can be confusing.
How to get Powercharm in Monster Hunter Wilds
Unlike most items in Monster Hunter Wilds, you can't craft Powercharm (or Armorcharm). You'll first need to reach High Rank and proceed along the main storyline. Once you have access to Chapter 4-2: Lurking Shadows, you'll gain access to Wounded Hollow. After completing Lurking Shadows, you'll meet an NPC called Cobb in Suja, Peaks of Accord.
Cobb will have an optional quest that involves hunting down two Hirabami. You'll face them together, so always focus on one to eliminate it. After killing both of them, return to Cobb, and he will reward you with the Powercharm.
Image via Destructoid
How to get Armorcharm in Monster Hunter Wilds
Once you complete the optional quest from Cobb, another NPC called Rex will contact you at the exact location. Called As Gatekeeper, you'll have to hunt two Ajarakan at Wounded Hollow as part of the quest.
This is a tough fight (this monster tested me thoroughly in the main questline). Make sure to target one at first and keep them separated to boost your chances of success. Once you eliminate both, go back to Rex to get your Armorcharm.
After obtaining the items, go to your tent and move both objects to your inventory. The two items will boost your defense and offense by being in your inventory, which is an excellent set of buffs. While you'll need to make a fair bit of progress to get these items, both of them are essential for endgame builds.

entry.title: Verdansk finally returns to Call of Duty Warzone and gets an official release date
entry.summary:
Call of Duty: Warzone had its fifth anniversary on March 10, 2025, and to celebrate the occasion, Activision will finally reintroduce the fan-favorite map, Verdansk.
It's time to mark the date on the calendar – Verdansk returns to Call of Duty: Warzone on April 3, 2025.
We will get to experience the original version of Verdansk, which came out in 2020. Yes, it will have all the fan-favorite hotdrop locations, including the TV Station, Military Base, Airport, Superstore, and more.
Verdansk was the first map in Warzone for many players, including me. Now that it's finally coming back, it will also bring a lot of memories from those early days of the game. As their post on X says, "It's time to revisit a place of unforgettable memories," things are about to get a lot more nostalgic for Warzone veterans.
This map will be a part of the Season 3 update, which also drops on the same date. So, at the time of writing, Verdansk is only 24 days away.
While the map is making a return, the gameplay mechanics from the original Warzone will not be coming back. It will stick to the mechanics from Black Ops 6. So, some things won't be the same as they used to be, it seems.
According to SteamCharts, Call of Duty has been facing a steady decline in the player count since December 2024. With the map coming back, hopefully, we hope to be able to see a rise in its player count.

Inventory management is crucial for any adventure, and it’s a task that might be best suited to a sentient backpack. There aren’t many games that offer such an essential ally, but the newly revealed Rootbound looks to provide a beautifully realized take on the concept.
Rootbound comes from a German studio called Brainlag Games, which was established in 2024 and has former devs from Piranha Bytes among its roster. As the trailer notes, the minds behind this one previously worked on games like Gothic, Risen, and Flex. If the first look is any indication, they have something special in the works in this stylish physics-based outing.
The environmental aesthetics alone remind me of a mix between A Short Hike and Tunic, with a dash of Death’s Door sprinkled in for good measure. The setting is fittingly bleak, as our plantling hero ventures forth to uncover the secrets behind the island of Akara and a civilization long since forgotten.
As for that backpack, its mighty tongue wagging from its pouch, it does more than just hold your items and equipment. It serves as a silent companion and can toss you the items you need as long as it’s in the mood. With sentience comes risk, though, as enemies can notice the backpack and focus their attacks on it.
All the while, a blight runs amok throughout the land, spreading its misery through rain that you’ll need to avoid. Torches and campfires provide a brief reprieve, and it all looks like it could swirl together to create a unique mood. Rootbound is currently planned for a 2026 launch on PC via Steam.

entry.title: Is X down? How to check server status and more
entry.summary:
Popular social media service X, formerly Twitter, is down for the second time in a single day as users from all over the world have reported incidents of an outage.
Unlike the first one, the latest incident seems to be for a longer duration, and as of writing, the servers still remain out of service. While the exact cause behind the incident is unknown, here's what you can to in the meantime that ensure that there are no problems from your end.
How to check X server status
The best way to check server status for X is using Downdetector. Usually, you'll see a spike in the number of users reporting outages in your region. This can be used to check the server status of any website, but it's extra helpful in case a social media site like X goes down. Usually, a lot of gaming studios will announce about servers being down on social media platforms like X. In this case, relying on third-party sites like Downdetector is the only solution.
Image via Destructoid
Usually, there's not much to do from your end if the servers are down. Whatever the cause might be, it has to be fixed from X's end, and it can take a long time. We have had major outages back in 2024, when the site was down right after Elon Musk completed his takeover. Whether the latest outage stretches for a similarly long period remains to be seen.
If you want to check the server status (of X or of another platform), just complete the following steps.
Go to Downdetector
Select your region.
Type in the name of the service you want to check.
If there's a spike of red towers, it simply means that the servers are down.
If there is no spike of red towers and you still can't access the servers, chances are that the issue is at your end.

entry.title: How to complete Lucky You in Disney Dreamlight Valley
entry.summary:
During Disney Dreamlight Valley's Spring Into the Lucky You event, you'll find three-leaf and four-leaf clovers spawning around your village. While their main purpose is to craft the End of the Rainbow Cauldron, you'll also get a special shirt after completing the Lucky You Dreamlight task.
How to complete the Lucky You event task in Disney Dreamlight Valley
Finishing the Spring Into the Lucky You event's Lucky You duty requires collecting seven four-leaf clovers. You have from March 10 to 17, 2025, to find them before the event ends. There are two ways to get four-leaf clovers in Disney Dreamlight Valley:
Forage them around your Dreamlight Valley village.
Craft them using 10 three-leaf clovers and 500 Dreamlight.
Screenshot by Destructoid
Four-leaf clovers spawn once every 90 minutes in a random biome. Only one can appear at a time, so you'll need to hunt for them until you spot one. After finding one, you'll have an hour and a half of wait time before the next appears, giving you time to collect some three-leaf clovers, do a bit of farming, or decorate your village if you wish.
Screenshot by Destructoid
If you can't find any four-leaf clovers or are approaching the end of the Spring Into the Lucky You event, you can use 10 three-leaf clovers and 500 Dreamlight to craft one four-leaf clover. You can get Dreamlight by finishing your regular village tasks, while three-leaf clovers are a much more common variant that spawns around the map every 15 minutes. You'll find this recipe under Refined Materials in your crafting station.
Once you obtain seven four-leaf clovers through crafting or foraging, you'll complete the Lucky You event task, rewarding you with a green Lucky Shirt as proof of your accomplishment.

entry.title: AMD EPYC 9845 Makes For A Persuasive Upgrade With Performance & Energy Efficiency

But for those looking at upgrading from an existing EPYC 9004 series server and bound by the motherboard BIOS support and/or cooling/power capacity, 400 Watts is a sweet spot. Many of the existing platforms designed for EPYC 9004 Bergamo/Genoa(X) and now extended for EPYC 9005 Turin are limited to a 400 Watt TDP. The EPYC 9845 is AMD's top-end SKU for 400 Watts or less that allows for 160 dense cores (320 threads) per socket compared to the 128 core EPYC 9754 Bergamo. Effectively the same power level and 25% more -- and better (Zen 5C) -- cores. Plus with EPYC Turin supporting the new AMD P-State CPU frequency scaling driver there is greater headroom in optimizing for power efficiency if so desired. Years ago I wrote a piece about what I presumptuously defined as the "emerging" subgenre of city games that respond to the climate crisis, with its attendant catastrophes of unchecked capitalism and resurgent fascism. Today, it feels dangerously like that subgenre is "sub" no longer. We are engulfed in strategy sims where society is the rind between the formless terrors without and the only-human abusers within. entry.title: Assassin's Creed Shadows has leaked a month before release, and Ubisoft are cracking down on stealthy early videos
entry.summary:
In typical shinobi style, Assassin's Creed Shadows has slipped through the cracks of physical and digital retail and sneakishly released itself a month ahead of schedule. The game is due to launch on 20th March, but people are already posting photographs of boxed copies, while others say they've managed to lift a code from the crevices of the PlayStation store. Videos of the game have been popping up on Youtube like Ninja Whac-a-Moles, no sooner seen than shurikened by Ubisoft's lawyers. Quite how all this has happened remains to be explained, but Ubisoft are naturally rather annoyed. They've put out statements asking people to avoid sharing spoilers, plus the boilerplate cautionary note that any footage you encounter isn't representative of the quality of the final game.

entry.title: After junking Balatro's 18 rating, PEGI will develop "a more granular" rating system for gambling themes
entry.summary:
Sorcerous cardgame Balatro and slot machine RPG Luck Be A Landlord have been reclassified as fit for people aged 12 years and over by the Pan European Games Information board, after they were initially slapped with an 18 rating for "glamorising... the simulation of gambling". PEGI have made the change following a successful appeal against the 18 rating by Balatro's European publisher Sold Out and Luck Be A Landlord's Switch publisher Fangamer. They're also going to develop "a more granular set of classification criteria" for games that reference gambling, to distinguish jingling parodies of rentier capitalism from the one arm bandits found in actual casinos.

entry.title: A bolt of lightning, a shocking experience
entry.summary: God of Thunder, the Zelda-esque game, is now ready for public testing! Prepare yourself to take on the role of Thor, the god of thunder, as he battles his way through the three part game, facing enemies and challenging environmental puzzles, all to finally face down challenging end bosses, culminating in Loki himself. The implementation in ScummVM is slightly different from the original, in that whilst it has a high score table like the original, you don't have to go through the steps of creating an account and being limited to only a single savegame. Also, unfortunately, the game uses a special music format that will need to be implemented from scratch by someone with experience. So for now, no music playback will occur, though in-game sound effects play back fine. To participate in the testing, ensure you have a daily development build. The game itself is freeware, and can be downloaded from the Adept Software website. We encourage all players to submit feedback and bug reports through our issue tracker.And please take some screenshots along the way. Have you the skill to defeat Loki, or will you be defeated by the cunning enemies, or be stymied figuring out the puzzles. Play, and find out. >
